title: Ceiling height of corridors and passageways used as a means of egress

clauses.text: 3.7.3 The minimum ceiling height of the corridors and passageways used as a means of egress shall not be less than 2.4 m.
clauses.notes:
Means of egress - the continuous and unobstructed path of travel from any point in a building to a public way, of which a corridor or passageway forms the exit-access part.

The limit is lower than the 2.75 m a habitable room owes under Part 3 Sec 1.14.2.1(a), because a corridor is circulated through rather than occupied; smoke banking down from the ceiling is what the height protects against.
